So, I have an Antminer S4, produces 2,000Gh/s. When I first calculated this, I was earning about 200$ a month with it.

Is there one?

Cooling, electricity, and maintenance costs are the big issues. Have you read the article about a Chinese miner using about 2/3 produced power from a hydroelectric dam for his operation? They managed cheap electricity for three warehouses of miners, and a nearby town got consistent power.

Costs get more complicated the bigger you grow.

With your single miner, it can run all day and you make money, you check it before bed and when you wake up.

With a hundred miners, if you have power or heat issues, you can start losing massive amounts of money very quickly, so you need to either monitor it yourself or pay someone to monitor it at least 16 hours per day. You also need to pay rent to a factory-owner, but maybe you have a big garage that you are doing this in, in which case you are probably not having to add any additional per-month expenses there, but you need to manage your electricity and probably pay an electrician to make sure everything is built to spec.

Now imagine you are doing this with thousands of miners. You might want to have a "team" that does 24/7 monitoring and are likely paying for rent in a datacenter with environmental controls. All of this is going to cost you a sizeable amount of money, even if it is minimum-wage or carries contract fees. You might want to pay a good price to get someone that isn't going to redirect some of your hash power to their own mining pool account. Even an hour's worth of downtime can result in hundreds of dollars lost.
